ground_rules: Read .cursor/rules/swarm-coordination.mdc (incl. 'Lessons from the 2026-08 burn'), COORDINATION.md, and your OPEN_ISSUES entries before the first CLAIM.
Every task below has a kill criterion. When it fires: BLOCKED with the evidence, no further sweeps in that family; A1 reassigns.

Metric of record: tests/scenarios/synthetic/level_set_normal_path_sweep.py --seeds 0 1 2 3 4 (sample-level bg-aware ARI, bg recall, coverage, leaf counts). Baseline 2026-09-09: nulls 30/30, hierarchy 5/5 (5-6 of 6 fine leaves), linked_tori root K=2 5/5, nested root K=2 5/5 (2 leaves), bimodal_circle 2/5, two_gaussians_weak 2/5. Any change that lowers a null pass or a root K is a regression regardless of what else improves.

Acceptance-path code (level_set.py selection, recursion.py descent, controller.py scale search, evidence/*) changes land flag-gated with default off unless the task says otherwise; flipping a default needs the full 5-seed sweep in the DONE note.
Never weaken a test. @awaiting tests flip only on green evidence. One-off probes live in /tmp or are deleted before DONE.
Never run the whole suite in a cloud turn. Named chunks in swarm-coordination.mdc. Wrap pytest in timeout 600. Persistence is A6-only.
SI.tex is shared by section (see owns_files); edit only your sections, keep hunks local, and never restructure. paper.tex belongs to A6.

Leadership split: A1 manages. Director slug is claude-fable-5-thinking-high (fallback claude-fable-5-1-thinking-high). Everyone else: cursor-grok-4.5-high (fallback cursor-grok-4.6-high-fast). A missing slug does NOT block merges or REQUEST_TRACKER. Do not invent beyond director_backlog / the last director session.
A1 NEVER idles: merge, refill, or convene director — else EXIT the turn with no mailbox spam and no no-op commit. A1-T2/T3/T4 stay ready (standing). Marking them completed is what froze A1 after D1.
Workers: if your ready queue is empty, EXIT before merging integration and do not append a mailbox NOTE. Idle heartbeats are not work.

A1.turn_protocol: 0 honor orchestrator_directive/USER_DIRECTIVE. 1 convene Fable if director_pending unanswered OR last director_session is not Fable. 2 merge only MERGE-WORTHY tips (git diff --name-only integration...A* has paths besides COORDINATION.jsonl). 3 refill only from last Fable backlog. 4 else EXIT — no idle HELLO/NOTE/MERGE_DONE.

STANDING merge heartbeat. Never mark completed. A worker tip is merge-worthy iff `git diff --name-only origin/coord/integration...origin/coord/A*` lists any path other than COORDINATION.jsonl. Mailbox-only / idle-heartbeat / merge-of-integration tips are NOT merge-worthy: skip them (no chunks, no MERGE_DONE, no integration push).
